biotools.summary: GRABSEEDS is a command-line tool for extracting plant organ traits from digital images, employing computer vision and deep learning methods to accurately measure length, color, and other characteristics. The tool streamlines phenotyping workflows and supports association studies with agronomic traits and stress conditions.
